en.t: Her voice trembled as she recited the poem.

units.source_text: 大夫监说：“且慢，这是什么意思？”

en.t: The Taifu no Gen said, "Wait a moment. What does that mean?"

units.source_text: 突然把身一转，挨近来了。

en.t: Suddenly he turned around and came closer.

units.source_text: 乳母老太太吓得浑身发抖，面无人色。

en.t: The old nurse was so frightened that her whole body shook and her face went pale.

units.source_text: 两个女儿虽然也害怕，只得强颜作笑，代母亲辩解：

en.t: Although the two daughters were frightened too, they forced smiles and explained on their mother's behalf:

units.source_text: “家母之意如此：此人身患废疾，誓愿永不嫁人。

en.t: "What our mother meant was this: this lady suffers from a disabling illness and has vowed never to marry.

units.source_text: 倘违背其愿望，此人必然怀恨。

en.t: If her wish is violated, she will surely bear resentment.

units.source_text: 老人头脑糊涂，错说了恨杀神明。”

en.t: The old woman was confused and misspoke, saying something about resenting the gods to death."

units.source_text: 大夫监说：“嗯嗯，说的是，说的是。”

en.t: The Taifu no Gen said, "Mm, yes, that is right, that is right."

units.source_text: 他点点头，又说：“此诗作得极好！

en.t: He nodded and then said, "This poem is extremely well composed!

units.source_text: 小生名为乡人，却非愚民可比。

en.t: I may be called a country man, but I am not to be compared with ignorant commoners.
What is so remarkable about people from the capital?

units.source_text: 他们的事我全都懂得，你等不要小看我啊！”

en.t: I understand all their ways, so do not look down on me!"

units.source_text: 他想再作一首诗，大概是作不出了，就此辞去。

en.t: He wanted to compose another poem, but apparently could not manage it, so he took his leave.
